items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, no. We just made that album together. We never played any gigs. That was the whole existence of the relationship.

ctx.x: Did you work as a working unit as well?
No, no. We just made that album together. We never played any gigs. That was the whole existence of the relationship.
Then another recording, not too long after that – let me scroll down and get that exact date: a recording with Max Roach in Chicago. Could you talk a little bit about that date?
